description: A four-row composite EBSD figure for three annealed low-density steels (AN750-T, AN800-T, AN850-T), each row/column pairing one sample. (a) Phase-distribution maps (25 µm scale bars) colour-coded FCC green / BCC red, each with a printed phase-fraction table and IQ values: AN750-T FCC 0.074 / BCC 0.926, IQ FM 39 532.6, IQ B/TM 64 306.6; AN800-T 0.024 / 0.976, IQ FM 41 731.4, IQ B/TM 67 252.1; AN850-T 0.006 / 0.994, IQ FM 35 468.2, IQ B/TM 72 402.3. Every map carries a white dashed-box magnified inset (1 µm scale bar) annotated F, B/TM and FM. (b) Three Image-quality histograms (number fraction vs image quality (10^4)) with bimodal populations; legend assigns grey to FM, red to B/TM, blue to F. Printed values: AN750-T Peak I 41 750, Peak II 71 477, Ave 63 161; AN800-T 46 517 / 77 326 / 66 186; AN850-T 48 120 / 86 101 / 74 468. (c) Three KAM maps, colour bar Min 0 – Max 1.25, 25 µm scale bars, showing dark high-misorientation networks along phase boundaries and a black dashed box marking the region analysed in (d). (d) Three point-to-origin KAM profiles (Map value (°) vs distance) with 1 µm magnified KAM insets and grey characteristic-line arrows; KAM_AVE = 0.53 (AN750-T), 0.69 (AN800-T), 0.62 (AN850-T).

observations.observation: Panel (a) contains three EBSD phase-distribution maps, one per sample, each with a 25 µm scale bar and a magnified white dashed-box inset with a 1 µm scale bar annotated F, B/TM and FM.
The phase-fraction tables printed in (a) give FCC 0.074 / BCC 0.926 for AN750-T, FCC 0.024 / BCC 0.976 for AN800-T and FCC 0.006 / BCC 0.994 for AN850-T (FCC green, BCC red).
IQ values printed inside (a) are IQ FM 39 532.6 and IQ B/TM 64 306.6 (AN750-T), IQ FM 41 731.4 and IQ B/TM 67 252.1 (AN800-T), IQ FM 35 468.2 and IQ B/TM 72 402.3 (AN850-T).

Panel (b) shows a distinct bimodal image-quality distribution for all three samples; printed values are Peak I 41 750, Peak II 71 477, Ave 63 161 (AN750-T); Peak I 46 517, Peak II 77 326, Ave 66 186 (AN800-T); Peak I 48 120, Peak II 86 101, Ave 74 468 (AN850-T).
The colour legend shared by the (b) histograms assigns grey bars to FM, red bars to B/TM and blue bars to F, with the low-IQ red/Grey peak and the high-IQ blue peak.

Panel (c) KAM maps use a colour bar with Min 0 and Max 1.25 and 25 µm scale bars; dark (high misorientation) networks follow the phase boundaries, and a black dashed box marks the region later profiled in (d).
Panel (d) prints KAM_AVE = 0.53 for AN750-T, KAM_AVE = 0.69 for AN800-T and KAM_AVE = 0.62 for AN850-T.

In all three (d) profiles the KAM Map value (°) rises sharply to a maximum above the 1.0 ° gridline where the characteristic line crosses a boundary, then falls again; each profile is accompanied by a 1 µm magnified KAM inset with grey arrows marking the analysed lines.
Fig. 5 is titled/described as the phases separation strategy and interphase strain analysis based on EBSD.

The caption lists the panels as (a) Kikuchi pattern quality and phase distribution map, (b) Kikuchi pattern quality distribution statistics, (c) KAM, and (d) interphase stress quantification diagram, all with a Distance (µm) axis.
Retained austenite contents of AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T are 7.4%, 2.4% and 0.6% respectively, the decrease being attributed to reduced austenite stability.

The citing text states that the content of B/TM and FM is quantified using the Image Quality (IQ) values of Kikuchi patterns, with critical IQ values determined from points sampled inside the white dashed boxes.

The citing text reports significant strain concentrations at boundaries between ferrite and bainite/martensite, with AN800-T having the highest average KAM (KAM_AVE = 0.69°) due to its higher content of bainite and martensite.
The citing text states that bainite/tempered martensite and fresh martensite average about 1 µm while ferrite averages about 5 µm in size.

subfigures.description: Three EBSD phase-distribution maps (25 µm scale bars) for AN750-T, AN800-T and AN850-T, coloured FCC (green) / BCC (red), each with a phase-fraction table and printed IQ FM / IQ B/TM values, plus a white dashed-box 1 µm magnified inset labelled F, B/TM, FM.

Three bimodal image-quality histograms (number fraction vs image quality (10^4)), with grey = FM, red = B/TM, blue = F; peaks and averages printed in each panel (e.g. AN850-T Peak I 48 120, Peak II 86 101, Ave 74 468).
Three KAM maps with a Min 0 / Max 1.25 colour bar and 25 µm scale bars; dark, high-misorientation networks trace phase boundaries, and a black dashed box marks the region magnified for (d).

Three point-to-origin KAM line profiles (Map value (°) vs distance in µm) from the black-boxed regions, each with a 1 µm magnified KAM inset and grey arrows for the characteristic lines; KAM_AVE printed as 0.53, 0.69 and 0.62.
